title: Extend two-open derived object data to the ambient scheme
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], W and V opens of X, and fix derived categories of module sheaves [def-pc-derived-category] in common Hom universe w on X, W, V and W intersect V. All direct restrictions, relative restrictions, and composition isomorphisms below are the canonical ones of [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps]. Write JW and JV for restriction from X to W and V, SW and SV for restriction from W and V to W intersect V, and sW and sV for the canonical isomorphisms JW followed by SW and JV followed by SV to direct restriction from X to W intersect V. Given A in D(O_W), B in D(O_V), and c : SW(A) isomorphic to SV(B), there exist G in D(O_X), jW : JW(G) isomorphic to A and jV : JV(G) isomorphic to B such that sW(G) inverse followed by SW(jW) followed by c equals sV(G) inverse followed by SV(jV). No covering, quasi-compactness, perfectness, support or boundedness assumption is imposed.

source.place: cohomology.tex, lemma-glue, direct-image cone construction without a cover hypothesis

proof.text: Apply relative_open_difference_diagram to obtain the difference map d between the explicit direct-image sum and overlap direct image, the local projections pW and pV, their split local normal forms, and the overlap difference equation.

Complete d to a distinguished triangle with first map f. Exact restriction gives distinguished triangles on both opens. Compare each with its split biproduct triangle, using the supplied local isomorphism on second terms and the identity on third terms. Complete the triangle morphism and apply the two-out-of-three isomorphism lemma. Its first map is the composite of restriction of f with the local projection, so these composites define jW and jV. This is the same categorical fiber-projection argument as in the existing covering object-gluing proof. Import all Sheaf.AlgebraicGeometry.DerivedOpenGluingObjects and apply its existing proved private AlgebraicGeometry.isIso_fiber_projection twice; no covering premise is needed by this categorical helper.

Precompose the overlap difference identity by restriction of f. Naturality of the canonical composition comparisons rewrites the left side as the difference of the two transition composites. The right side is zero because f followed by d is zero in a distinguished triangle. sub_eq_zero gives the required transition equation. Apply the existing proved private AlgebraicGeometry.compatible_of_difference from the same imported module, instead of duplicating its naturality calculation.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_ambient_open_gluing_object
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (W V : X.Opens)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings W.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings V.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (W ⊓ V).toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    (A : schemeDerivedCategory W.toScheme) (B : schemeDerivedCategory V.toScheme) :
    let JW := (schemeOpenRestriction X W).mapDerivedCategory
    let JV := (schemeOpenRestriction X V).mapDerivedCategory
    let SW := (schemeOpenOverlapRestriction X
      (homOfLE inf_le_left : W ⊓ V ⟶ W)).mapDerivedCategory
    let SV := (schemeOpenOverlapRestriction X
      (homOfLE inf_le_right : W ⊓ V ⟶ V)).mapDerivedCategory
    let sW := schemeDerivedOpenRestrictionCompIso X (homOfLE inf_le_left : W ⊓ V ⟶ W)
    let sV := schemeDerivedOpenRestrictionCompIso X (homOfLE inf_le_right : W ⊓ V ⟶ V)
    ∀ (c : SW.obj A ≅ SV.obj B),
      ∃ (G : schemeDerivedCategory X) (jW : JW.obj G ≅ A) (jV : JV.obj G ≅ B),
        sW.inv.app G ≫ SW.map jW.hom ≫ c.hom = sV.inv.app G ≫ SV.map jV.hom
